body:
Each successful build produces a versioned release: its artifacts and a record of how they were made.

- One version per build. Solace proposes the next version (patch, minor, major) and the human approves it; it is written to every manifest that holds a version (`Cargo.toml`, `gleam.toml`, `package.json`, `tauri.conf.json`), so they never disagree.
- Each artifact is stored with its version, checksum, size, the source snapshot it was built from and the build's log.
- Artifacts are stored in an output folder, `build-output` by default, set on the Build page (not under `.solace/`, which is off-limits). The folder is kept out of git and has a **read-only** option: when on, agents may read it but not write to it.
- From the page: download an artifact, or open its folder in the desktop app.

A release is what the Deploy Page rollout milestone later takes.

Depends on: build: run from the Build page.
title: build: artifacts and versions
